https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.17

vision-runtime.js is the unmodified vision_bundle.cjs distribution file, renamed
for correct JavaScript content type in static hosting. The wasm directory contains
the matching SIMD and non-SIMD runtime files from the same package version.
Source-map comments refer to upstream debug files not bundled with this app.

The hand landmark model is fetched separately from Google's MediaPipe model storage.
